notice: SIMULATION MODE — NOT FOR OPERATIONAL USE. Every value below is illustrative and unreviewed. No external guideline validates this model. ADA and British Thoracic Society material may inform individual thresholds; they do not validate Valoris.

stale_after_sec.rationale: Reading older than this is treated as stale. Placeholder pending occupational physician review.

missing_after_sec.rationale: Reading older than this is treated as absent entirely. Placeholder pending occupational physician review.

estimated_core_temp_sd_confidence_drop_c.rationale: Standard deviation of an estimated core temperature above which confidence drops a further step, on top of the cap that any estimate already imposes. Mirrors core_temp_estimate_sd_confidence_drop_c in the physiology config; the two are consulted by different layers and should be reviewed together.

band_safe_max_score.rationale: Upper bound of the SAFE band. Placeholder pending occupational physician review.

band_caution_max_score.rationale: Upper bound of the CAUTION band. CAUTION exists to create lead time before CRITICAL.

band_high_max_score.rationale: Upper bound of the HIGH band; above this the composite reads CRITICAL.

weight_physiological.rationale: Composite weight for the physiological subscore.

weight_environmental.rationale: Composite weight for the environmental subscore.

weight_proximity.rationale: Composite weight for the proximity subscore.

weight_profile.rationale: Composite weight for the profile vulnerability subscore.

override_spo2_critical_pct.rationale: Baseline SpO2 hard-override threshold for a person with no respiratory risk. Placeholder pending occupational physician review.

override_spo2_confirm_readings.rationale: Consecutive breaching readings required to confirm the SpO2 override and reject single-sample artefacts.

override_core_temp_critical_c.rationale: Estimated core temperature hard-override threshold for average heat tolerance. Core temperature here is ESTIMATED, never measured.

override_hr_fraction_of_max.rationale: Fraction of age-adjusted maximum heart rate at or above which the override fires.

override_scba_pressure_pct.rationale: SCBA cylinder pressure at or below which the override fires. Unknown pressure is treated as worst case.

override_escape_blocked_fire_distance_m.rationale: A blocked escape route fires the override when the fire front is at or inside this distance.

phys_weight_hr.rationale: Weight of heart rate within the physiological subscore.

phys_weight_spo2.rationale: Weight of SpO2 deviation within the physiological subscore.

phys_weight_core_temp.rationale: Weight of estimated core temperature within the physiological subscore.

phys_weight_fatigue.rationale: Weight of the fatigue index within the physiological subscore.

phys_weight_time_on_task.rationale: Weight of continuous time on task within the physiological subscore.

hr_max_age_constant_bpm.rationale: Constant in the age-adjusted maximum heart rate estimate (220 minus age). A crude population formula, not an individual measurement.

hr_fraction_low.rationale: Fraction of age-adjusted max HR at or below which heart rate contributes nothing.

hr_fraction_high.rationale: Fraction of age-adjusted max HR at or above which heart rate contributes the maximum.

spo2_deviation_low_pct.rationale: Deviation below the individual's own SpO2 baseline at or under which nothing is contributed.

spo2_deviation_high_pct.rationale: Deviation below the individual's own SpO2 baseline at or over which the maximum is contributed.

spo2_deviation_min_span_pct.rationale: Floor applied after respiratory-risk tightening so the SpO2 ramp never collapses to zero width.

core_temp_low_c.rationale: Estimated core temperature at or below which nothing is contributed, for average heat tolerance.

core_temp_high_c.rationale: Estimated core temperature at or above which the maximum is contributed, for average heat tolerance.

fatigue_low_pct.rationale: Effective fatigue index at or below which nothing is contributed.

fatigue_high_pct.rationale: Effective fatigue index at or above which the maximum is contributed.

time_on_task_low_min.rationale: Continuous time on task at or below which nothing is contributed.

time_on_task_high_min.rationale: Continuous time on task at or above which the maximum is contributed.

phys_weight_glucose.rationale: Weight of glucose within the physiological subscore, applied ONLY for a firefighter wearing a CGM. For everyone else the weight is zero and the remaining terms renormalise, so an unmonitored firefighter is not penalised for a channel they do not have.

glucose_stale_after_sec.rationale: Glucose-specific staleness threshold. CGM reports roughly every five minutes, so the system-wide 60-second threshold would mark every normal reading stale. Mirrors glucose_stale_after_sec in config/risk-diabetes.json; review them together.

glucose_missing_after_sec.rationale: Glucose-specific missing threshold, roughly three missed CGM cadences.

glucose_hypo_override_mmol_l.rationale: Lag-corrected glucose at or below which a hard override fires. Hypoglycaemia incapacitates quickly and must not be outvoted by a weighted average. INVENTED and unsourced — see docs/CLINICAL_ASSUMPTIONS.md item 29.

glucose_low_mmol_l.rationale: Lag-corrected glucose at or below which the low-glucose contribution reaches maximum.

glucose_ideal_low_mmol_l.rationale: Lower edge of the range treated as unremarkable during exertion; at or above this, low glucose contributes nothing.

glucose_hyper_low_mmol_l.rationale: Lag-corrected glucose at or below which the high-glucose contribution is zero.

glucose_hyper_high_mmol_l.rationale: Lag-corrected glucose at or above which the high-glucose contribution reaches maximum. Sustained hyperglycaemia during exertion carries dehydration and ketoacidosis risk.

env_weight_co.rationale: Weight of carbon monoxide within the environmental subscore.

env_weight_pm25.rationale: Weight of PM2.5 within the environmental subscore.

env_weight_heat.rationale: Weight of ambient heat within the environmental subscore.

co_low_ppm.rationale: Ambient CO at or below which nothing is contributed, before cumulative-exposure tightening.

co_high_ppm.rationale: Ambient CO at or above which the maximum is contributed, before cumulative-exposure tightening.

pm25_low_ugm3.rationale: PM2.5 at or below which nothing is contributed, before cumulative-exposure tightening.

pm25_high_ugm3.rationale: PM2.5 at or above which the maximum is contributed, before cumulative-exposure tightening.

ambient_temp_low_c.rationale: Humidity-adjusted ambient temperature at or below which nothing is contributed, for average heat tolerance.

ambient_temp_high_c.rationale: Humidity-adjusted ambient temperature at or above which the maximum is contributed, for average heat tolerance.

humidity_reference_pct.rationale: Relative humidity above which evaporative cooling is penalised.

humidity_heat_penalty_c_per_10pct.rationale: Degrees added to effective ambient temperature per 10 percentage points of humidity above the reference. A crude stand-in for a heat index.

prox_weight_fire_distance.rationale: Weight of distance to fire front within the proximity subscore.

prox_weight_escape_route.rationale: Weight of escape route status within the proximity subscore.

prox_weight_scba.rationale: Weight of remaining SCBA pressure within the proximity subscore.

fire_front_high_distance_m.rationale: Distance to fire front at or below which the maximum is contributed.

fire_front_low_distance_m.rationale: Distance to fire front at or above which nothing is contributed.

escape_route_degraded_score.rationale: Contribution of a degraded escape route.

escape_route_blocked_score.rationale: Contribution of a blocked escape route.

scba_pressure_low_score_pct.rationale: SCBA pressure at or above which nothing is contributed.

scba_pressure_high_score_pct.rationale: SCBA pressure at or below which the maximum is contributed.

prof_weight_respiratory.rationale: Weight of respiratory risk within the profile subscore.

prof_weight_heat_tolerance.rationale: Weight of heat tolerance within the profile subscore.

prof_weight_fitness.rationale: Weight of fitness within the profile subscore.

prof_weight_prev_shift.rationale: Weight of previous shift hours within the profile subscore.

prof_weight_conditions.rationale: Weight of declared condition count within the profile subscore.

prof_weight_cumulative_exposure.rationale: Weight of cumulative CO and heat exposure indices within the profile subscore.

resp_risk_score_none.rationale: Profile contribution for no declared respiratory risk.

resp_risk_score_mild.rationale: Profile contribution for mild respiratory risk.

resp_risk_score_moderate.rationale: Profile contribution for moderate respiratory risk.

resp_risk_score_high.rationale: Profile contribution for high respiratory risk.

heat_tolerance_score_low.rationale: Profile contribution for low heat tolerance.

heat_tolerance_score_avg.rationale: Profile contribution for average heat tolerance.

heat_tolerance_score_high.rationale: Profile contribution for high heat tolerance.

prev_shift_low_h.rationale: Previous shift length at or below which nothing is contributed.

prev_shift_high_h.rationale: Previous shift length at or above which the maximum is contributed.

condition_score_per_condition.rationale: Profile contribution per declared condition, capped at the maximum. A count is a poor proxy for clinical severity and is flagged for review.

resp_risk_spo2_alert_shift_pct_per_level.rationale: Per respiratory-risk level (mild 1, moderate 2, high 3), SpO2 alerting fires earlier: the override threshold rises and the deviation ramp tightens.

heat_tolerance_core_temp_shift_c.rationale: Core temperature limits shift down by this amount for low heat tolerance and up by it for high heat tolerance.

heat_tolerance_ambient_shift_c.rationale: Ambient heat limits shift down by this amount for low heat tolerance and up by it for high heat tolerance.

prev_shift_fatigue_pct_per_hour.rationale: Fatigue index carried into this incident per hour of the previous shift.

cumulative_co_tightening_frac.rationale: At a cumulative CO exposure index of 1.0, CO and PM2.5 thresholds tighten by this fraction.

cumulative_heat_tightening_max_c.rationale: At a cumulative heat exposure index of 1.0, ambient heat limits tighten by this many degrees.
